header.title: We are so excited to welcome you to Winners Chapel International Milwaukee Wisconsin
header.description: Here are some information on our services and events.

sunday.title: Sunday Services
sunday.subtitle: Every Sunday
sunday.location: 8159 W Brown Deer Road, Milwaukee, WI 53233
sunday.whatToExpect: Our services are packaged with intense worship and inspirational teachings from the Word of God. You should expect a transformation as you attend.

ministries.title: Children's Ministry
ministries.description: A safe, clean, secured, and well-monitored environment where children are taught the Word in ways they understand. We have an equipped children's ministry staffed by passionate members ready to care for your children while you enjoy uninterrupted worship.

ministries.title: Teens Ministry
ministries.description: A mini church where an awesome interactive worship experience holds, engaging and challenging young minds.

ministries.title: Youth Ministry
ministries.description: A vibrant and kingdom-focused ministry for young adults.

uiText.childrenDescription: We have a fully equipped children's ministry with passionate members ready to attend to your children while you enjoy an uninterrupted worship experience.
uiText.teensDescription: Our teens ministry is a mini church where an awesome interactive worship experience holds, engaging and challenging young minds. Your teenagers will love it here.
uiText.sundayTimeHeading: First Service: 8:00 am | Second Service: 10:30 am
uiText.youthDescription: This ministry caters for millennials. It is vibrant and kingdom focused. Millennials love it here and have a platform to show their giftings and talents at 12 Noon Sunday Worship Experience.
uiText.parkingDescription: Are you planning a visit to church? When you come in for the first time, drive towards the Main Lobby with your hazard lights on and a Parking Team member will be available to attend to you.
uiText.ctaHeading: You were meant to enjoy a life free in Christ.
uiText.ctaSubheading: Take your first step towards it.
uiText.ctaDescription: We exist to bring God's freedom to everyone. We love to care for people who have been hurt. This is our mandate.
